ratings.comment: Do not recommend. Although her resume is very impressive. The material she teaches is not. The material she teaches does not reflect what they ask us to do during the labs. I wanted to minor in CS but this class unmotivated me to do so because she did not teach well. Even through hours of tutoring I still failed this class. 0/5

I took her for cs470 and I found her to be much easier than expected. However, I was hoping to build an impressive capstone project, but all of the grading in this class was centered around analysis and not really on app performance. So I passed with an A but my project still needs a lot of work. She is really nice and enthusiastic though.
Really bad a grading and very little effort put into the labs. SEGFAULT errors for everyone, yay!

The professor offers no extra help and is very unclear on most topics. The lecture has nothing to do with the lab and the tests are very difficult if you don't understand the topics. The professor is no help and does not give clear answers for questions you ask. The course work is heavy and is mostly self taught. Leal is no help at all.
ratings.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

ratings.comment: Took her python class and it was really bad. Did not think it could get worse with UNIX. Prepare to teach yourself. Grading is terrible too. Quizzes don't reflect what she teaches in class. Teaches is an overstatement of what she does though. I've had her give me poor scores because she couldn't run my code even though it worked on my end.

I learned nothing by taking her course. She would go over the subject and already assume you knew how to do it. She demeaned students when the class asked questions and I was lost the entire time. Avoid this professor at all costs!

Just stop. Stop reading and choose a different class. Very annoying to hear speak, seemed like she was never prepared, lectures most of class then gives you in class work thats supposed to take an hour but you get 20 mins. Have to go to the makers space for homework (takes like 2 hours at least). A LOT OF BUSY BS WORK. Just don't take her.

If you're a first year CS major you have no other options. She thinks people flunk cause the material is hard, but she just doesnt teach you anything. Luckily she didnt design the labs. So teach yourself straight from the book and look for examples online, the labs correlate with the book more or less. DONT RELY ON HER LECTURES.
ratings.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

ratings.comment: Unfortunately I would not recommend taking her (but since she is the only teacher for this class you are kind of left with no choice). She does not seek to help students, can be unresponsive to emails and attempts to leverage her position as a professor to occasionally talk down to her students. Be wary

She's alright. Her voice is very high pitched which is kind of like nails on a chalk board at times. Other than that she can forget sometimes important aspects for the project one is working on. She does give good advice when needed however.
